'''Nere''' is a new character introduced in the world of Vilanciel. She is one of the blood descendants of the people of the historical Bariura Empire in Grand Gaia and is the grandmother of Liana and Luciana.

==History==

Nere warns Liana in Bariura Lake Castle while the Summoner, Tilith and Reda eavesdrops on them. Upon being found, Tilith introduces herself as a Goddess from Grand Gaia. Much to Nere's surprise, Nere introduces herself and her granddaughters as descendants of people of Bariura Empire, then informs the group of the situation in Vilanciel, particularly about the Mystical Wolf.

In [[Vilanciel:EX2|Divine Beast's Prison]], Nere requests Summoner to defeat the Divine Beast. Upon defeating the Divine Beast, Nere tells the Summoner that the Divine Beast was created by [[Selvia (character)|a member of Bariura Imperial Family]] to slay the Mystical Wolf, but was sealed away due to it being too difficult to control. Nere also reveals how the Emperor of Bariura met his demise, and how the [[Sirius (character)|Crown Prince]] led the remaining people back to Grand Gaia.
